summary: iter-31 auto-derive company_id/partner_id on center-only transactions — ALL 9 backend tests passing on first run. Verified: (1) POST /api/transactions with only center_id derives company from center.company_id, (2) with batches, derives both company + partner, (3) caller-provided values preserved, (4) isolated center returns None without crash, (5) reimbursement legacy pay creates txn with correct company+partner, (6) payroll pay creates Salary: txn with correct tagging, (7) asset purchase final approve creates Asset Purchase: txn tagged, (8) backfill endpoint returns {scanned,updated,distinct_centers} and is idempotent (run-2 updated=0), (9) non-admin (hr) gets 403 on backfill. Also verified center form accepts company_id via PUT (ConfigDict extra='allow').
critical_code_review_comments: Backfill run on production DB: scanned=312 remaining dangling txns, updated=0 — a previous iteration already ran the backfill and resolved all resolvable centers. The remaining 312 belong to 76 distinct centers that have NO batches / NO legacy partner_id / NO center.company_id / NO txn history — so _derive_context_for_center correctly returns None for them (no false updates). If E1 wants those to be tagged, admin must manually set center.company_id + partner_id (frontend form now supports this via the new Default Company/Partner dropdowns).
server.py is now 6708 lines — consider modularising (transactions/approvals/payroll/reimb/assets each into own router file) in a future refactor.
_derive_context_for_center helper is well-factored, cached per-run in backfill loop, and safely handles missing center. Good defensive coding.
